name: ship-pr-dev
title: Ship PR
description: Prepare a branch for a human-mergeable PR with credit-aware host-native workers, one independent review gate, deterministic verification and CI waiting, and no merge action.
notes:
## What it does

Ship PR owns delivery from a local branch to a human-reviewable PR. The coordinator keeps architecture, Git, PR state, and final acceptance while bounded workers handle separable implementation, independent review, difficult CI diagnosis, and the final report-only learning pass.

## Credit routing

- Codex workers request gpt-5.6-luna with max effort and fresh self-contained context.
- Claude Code workers request claude-sonnet-5, normally at high effort when supported.
- OpenCode workers inherit the user's default model.
- Trivial work stays inline; standard/deep work has one writer and bounded read-only reviewer caps.
- Deterministic checks, Git, PR operations, and CI polling stay in the coordinator.

## Review ownership

review-code-dev is the only full review gate. Frontend and specialist lenses run inside that review, eliminating the previous Ship PR board plus frontend pass plus final review duplication.

## Readiness

Ship PR never merges and never reports success until local evidence is fresh, review blockers are resolved, every visible non-skipped latest-SHA CI item is green, and capture-learning-tools completed report-only.

changes: Ignore Python bytecode caches produced when bundled tests are imported by discovery-based runners.
Distinguish agent workflow packages from application code during impact classification.
Prevent skill-only Python and security references from escalating small PRs to backend or security review tiers.
Add regression coverage for skill-only and real application risk paths, without leaving Python cache artifacts.
Route Codex workers to gpt-5.6-luna/max, Claude Code workers to claude-sonnet-5, and leave OpenCode on its default model.
Add explicit trivial, standard, and deep agent budgets, single-writer ownership, fresh work orders, worker resume, and routing telemetry.
Remove the duplicate Ship PR review board and standalone frontend mega-pass; review-code-dev now owns one bounded review gate.
Add 10/25/50-minute local targets, non-blocking reassessment checkpoints, worker progress checks, and separate external-CI timing so small changes cannot silently drift for an hour.
Preserve the strict latest-SHA all-visible-CI gate and canonical capture-learning-tools handoff.
Last published Companion baseline before the credit-aware redesign.

commands.name: Ship branch as PR
commands.desc: Finish scoped work, verify, review, commit, push, create or update the PR, and wait for latest-SHA CI.

commands.name: Prepare local PR handoff
commands.desc: Run cleanup, verification, and review but stop before remote mutation.
